Add attribute blocks, explosives, petroleum blocks, dry ice, etc,
Explosives have the property of explosion, causing a large amount of damage to surrounding organisms,
Oil blocks have combustion properties and can cause combustion effects on organisms,
Dry ice has the property of refrigeration and can cause a cold effect on organisms
